description: One financial field for a Taiwan company, newest period first. Taiwan's own open data. History is shallow: statements start in 2026 and monthly revenue in October 2025. Income figures are cumulative from 1 January (basis year_to_date). Discrete quarters use basis quarter_derived. Free with no sign-in: 2317 (Hon Hai), 2454 (MediaTek), 2308 (Delta Electronics), 2412 (Chunghwa Telecom). One page via limit/cursor. Costs 1 credit. A figure can be withheld (null/absent beats a guess) and can change or disappear when a later filing arrives. Figures follow the source, including any adjustments described with the figure. This is filing data, not investment advice.

basis.description: Filter by the basis of the figure.

cursor.description: The meta.next_cursor of the previous page.

id.description: A 4-digit stock code (2330) or an 8-digit unified business number.
